title: Marqeta and zerohash make stablecoins spendable on cards
message_html: Marqeta and zerohash make stablecoins spendable on cards ...
snippet: zerohash, a leading infrastructure platform powering crypto, stablecoin, and tokenized asset capabilities for financial institutions, and Marqeta, Inc. (NASDAQ: MQ), the modern card issuing platform, today announced they will collaborate to integrate zerohash’s stablecoin infrastructure into Marqeta
